reason: The price is not the problem for a salon my size, but I have never heard of this app and no other owner or my distributor uses it. I will not move my staff's billing and my customers' details onto something nobody I know has tried.
objection: If the app stops working or WhatsApp bills don't go out on a packed Sunday or Diwali week, who picks up the phone and fixes it right then? A one-time training at the salon doesn't answer that.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three salon owners I know personally running it for a few months without trouble, plus a named person I can call on Sundays and festival days who actually answers.
